key_insight: EDEN is a large, fully anonymized Italian emergency-department clinical notes corpus with a smaller expertly annotated subset for structured information extraction.
clinical_relevance: The dataset can help train and evaluate medical NLP systems for Italian ED documentation, especially for extracting structured fields from unstructured notes.
method: Collected ~4 million ED clinical notes from Italian hospitals
Manually annotated ~6,000 notes with a 132-item CRF for dyspnea and loss of consciousness
Used iterative clinician review to refine ambiguous item definitions and labels
evidence_signal: The paper reports corpus statistics, annotation scheme details, and zero-shot CRF-filling baselines using Gemma-27B and MedGemma-27B.
watch_item: The annotated subset is highly imbalanced and limited to two emergency scenarios, which may constrain generalization.
paper_title: EDEN: A Large-Scale Corpus of Clinical Notes for Italian
